claim: Characteristic Solution Regimes §: overdamped 'surrender', critically damped 'purposeful arrival', underdamped 'overshoot and ring-back' are audibly distinct regimes; the forward vector wants a student to name them by ear. Two latent errors a piece would expose: 'Two settling times (2/ω_n) to reach ~95%' (at t = 2/ω_n the critically damped curve has covered only ~59%; 95% needs ~4.7/ω_n), and the f_max formula's '+' sign (the first peak lies past the target, f_target − (f₀ − f_target)·e^(−πζ/√(1−ζ²))).
